* Develop and execute social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and online presence.

* Analyse engagement, impressions, reach, follower growth, website traffic, and lead\-generation metrics.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Knowledge of AI\-based design and content\-creation tools is an advantage.

description:
**Senior Interior Designer**

**About the Role:**

We are seeking an experienced and creative **Senior Interior Designer** to join our dynamic team. As part of our design studio, you will play a key role in conceptualising, developing, and executing interior design solutions across residential, commercial, or institutional projects. You will collaborate with a team of interior designers, consultants, and project stakeholders to deliver high\-quality design outcomes aligned with client expectations and project goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the in\-house team of interior designers on design and execution assignments.
* Conduct site visits, take accurate measurements, and prepare detailed site reports.
* Develop multiple design layout alternatives based on client briefs and project requirements.
* Finalise interior layouts through iterative design discussions with clients and team leads.
* Understand and incorporate MEP services (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire\-fighting) into design proposals.
* Coordinate and manage communication with service consultants (Electrical, HVAC, etc.) for accurate integration of services.
* Prepare detailed design drawings, working drawings, and specifications for execution.
* Collect and verify consultant layouts and ensure they align with the final design.
* Maintain proper records and documentation using standard filing systems (digital and physical).
* Refrain from discussing project costs, contractor rates, or commercial aspects unless specifically instructed.
* Provide daily updates and progress reports to the Project Head or Director.
* Take on any additional tasks or responsibilities relevant to your role as assigned.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Interior Design / Architecture
* 5–8 years of proven experience in interior design execution
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Office, and design software such as SketchUp, Photoshop, or Revit (preferred)
* Strong knowledge of interior design detailing, materials, services integration, and construction processes
* Excellent communication, organisational, and team coordination skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively in a project\-based environment

**What We Offer:**

* Collaborative and creative work environment
* Opportunities to lead projects and contribute to the firm’s design development
* Exposure to end\-to\-end project execution
* Professional growth and learning opportunities under experienced leadership

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Interior design: 7 years (Required)

title: Senior Graphics Designer
description:
Sr. Graphic Designer \- Job Description

Experience Required: 5\-7 Years

Location: BKC, Mumbai

Department: Marketing / Brand / Creative

About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative and detail\-oriented Senior Graphic Designer/Jr. Art

Director with 5\-7 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should possess

strong design aesthetics, conceptual thinking, and hands\-on expertise across ATL, BTL, digital,

motion, and AI\-assisted creative production. This role requires someone who can translate

brand strategy into visually compelling communication across multiple platforms while

maintaining consistency and innovation.

The candidate should have experience working in a fast\-paced environment, preferably

across real estate, retail, lifestyle, luxury, or agency ecosystems, and be capable of

independently driving design projects from concept to execution.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

Creative Conceptualisation \& Art Direction

● Understand marketing and business briefs and translate them into strong creative

concepts and visual narratives.

● Conceptualise integrated campaigns across ATL, BTL, digital, social and on\-ground

platforms.

● Develop campaign Key Visuals (KVs), visual identities, moodboards, design systems

and overall art direction.

● Think beyond individual creatives and establish a cohesive visual language that can

extend across an entire campaign.

● Partner with marketing and content teams to develop ideas that are strategically

relevant as well as visually impactful.

● Bring fresh perspectives, references and creative thinking to campaign brainstorming

sessions.

ATL \& BTL Design

Conceptualise and execute communication across:

● Hoardings \& billboards

● Print advertisements

● Outdoor media

● Mall \& retail branding

● Store launch communication

● Event \& activation branding

● Kiosks \& installations

● POSM

● Brochures, flyers \& catalogues

● Signages \& wayfinding

● Promotional \& campaign collaterals

● Merchandise \& packaging

The candidate should have a strong understanding of large\-format design, print production

and how creative communication translates from a screen to a physical environment.

Digital \& Social

● Create visually compelling campaigns for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube

and other digital platforms.

● Develop static creatives, carousels, stories, digital advertisements, website banners,

emailers and performance marketing assets.

● Understand current social media formats and create platform\-first visual

communication rather than simply resizing ATL creatives.

● Work closely with social and content teams to develop visually distinctive content

properties.

Motion, GIFs \& Video

● Conceptualise and create GIFs, animated creatives, motion graphics and short\-form

digital content.

● Have working knowledge of video editing and the ability to create or supervise reels,

promotional videos and digital campaign assets.

● Provide visual direction for shoots, videos and other content production wherever

required.

AI \& New\-Age Creative Tools

● Have hands\-on experience with AI\-powered creative and design tools.

● Use AI for concept development, visualisation, image generation, moodboarding,

storyboarding, creative exploration and production.

● Be comfortable experimenting with tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, DALL·E,

Runway or similar platforms.

● Identify opportunities where AI can improve creative output, speed and efficiency

without compromising brand quality.

Brand Custodianship

● Maintain consistency of the brand's visual identity across all consumer touchpoints.

● Ensure all communication follows established brand guidelines while continuously

finding ways to keep the brand visually fresh.

● Review creative output from internal teams, agencies and external partners to ensure

quality and consistency.

Creative Ownership \& Team Collaboration

● Take end\-to\-end ownership of creative projects from brief and ideation through

execution and final delivery.

● Work closely with marketing, digital, social media, content, events and business

teams.

● Brief and guide junior designers, freelancers, agencies and production partners

wherever required.

● Review creative output and provide constructive design feedback.

● Manage multiple campaigns and briefs simultaneously while maintaining quality and

timelines.

● Coordinate with printers, fabricators and production vendors and ensure artwork is

technically production\-ready.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

● 5\-7 years of proven experience in graphic design/creative design.

● Proficiency in:

\- Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro)

\- Figma / Canva / Other modern design platforms

● Strong understanding of: Typography, layout, color theory, branding, and

composition.

● Experience in motion graphics/animation/GIF creation.

● Familiarity with AI\-powered design tools and prompt\-based creative generation.

● Strong understanding of print production and digital asset specifications.

● Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines efficiently.

Pay: ₹1,100,000\.00 \- ₹1,300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
